step1.label: Start
step1.title: Welcome to the new system
step1.desc: This short guide will walk you through the main screens you'll use daily so you can get started quickly.

step2.label: Overview
step2.title: System overview
step2.desc: The home screen shows your store's key info — remaining customer deposits, pending tasks, and quick links to other parts of the system.

step3.label: Chat
step3.title: Chat for team communication and notifications
step3.desc: Use chat to talk with teammates and receive real-time alerts — deposit/withdrawal requests, stock transfers, and announcements from managers.

step4.label: Deposit menu
step4.title: Deposit / Withdraw screen
step4.desc: The main hub for managing customer bottle deposits — create a new deposit, accept LINE requests, or withdraw a bottle for a customer.

step5.label: Manual deposit
step5.title: Create a manual deposit
step5.desc: When a customer drops off a bottle in person, tap New deposit, pick the product, enter the customer's name and phone, then confirm — the system issues a deposit code automatically.

step6.label: LINE deposit
step6.title: Accept a deposit submitted via LINE
step6.desc: Customers can submit deposit requests through the LINE OA. Staff just open the incoming request, verify the bottle, and confirm — the record is saved instantly.

step7.label: Withdraw
step7.title: Withdraw a bottle for a customer
step7.desc: When a customer comes to withdraw, search by deposit code or phone, pick the bottle, verify with the customer, and confirm — stock is updated automatically.

storeDetail.lineGroupHowToStep1: Open LINE Developers Console → select this branch's Channel → Messaging API tab → enable "Allow bot to join group chats"
storeDetail.lineGroupHowToStep2: Open the LINE app → create or open the staff group that should receive notifications
storeDetail.lineGroupHowToStep3: Tap the group name → "Invite" → search for and invite the branch's LINE OA into the group (you must be friends with the LINE OA first)
storeDetail.lineGroupHowToStep4: Once the bot joins the group, type "groupid" or "/groupid" in the group chat
storeDetail.lineGroupHowToStep5: The bot will reply with the Group ID (starting with C...) — copy it into the field above and click Save
storeDetail.lineGroupHowToNote: Note: the branch's Channel must already have a valid Webhook URL and Token configured, otherwise the bot cannot reply with the Group ID
